Low Earth orbit satellite power simulators — verifying that periodic solar panel charging balances dark-side eclipse consumption across an orbit, identifying the mission epoch where battery reserves never drop below operational thresholds.
parsed.explanation: The optimal approach uses a greedy single-pass algorithm that advances the candidate start whenever the running gas balance falls below zero, relying on the invariant that a complete circuit is guaranteed if total gas meets total cost. This achieves O(n) time and O(1) space compared to the naive O(n²) method of simulating the entire loop from every possible station. In production, this pattern enables real-time feasibility verification and cycle-offset selection in energy-constrained, periodic scheduling pipelines without expensive backtracking.
